card.title: Architect
card.description: Translate business requirements into scalable technical foundations. This involves mapping out system constraints, defining API data contracts, and designing modular architectures like micro-frontends before writing a single line of code.

card.description: Create the guardrails that accelerate team velocity. By establishing strict TypeScript definitions and centralizing design systems, you ensure UI consistency and maintainability across multiple enterprise applications.

card.title: Engineer

card.title: Scale
card.description: Optimize the environment for both the user and the engineering team. Continuously monitor performance metrics, modernize build infrastructure, and improve Developer Experience (DX) to elevate overall team output.

AboutMe.title: ABOUT
AboutMe.introduction: I’m a Senior Front-End Developer who believes UI must be both visually compelling and structurally bulletproof.
AboutMe.description: With over 7 years of experience building enterprise web applications, I bridge the gap between product vision and system engineering. My philosophy is simple: UIs shouldn't just look spectacular they must be built as scalable, testable software that accelerates overall team velocity.
AboutMe.second-description: I specialize in high-performance React architectures, micro-frontend infrastructures, and centralized design systems. Whether it's driving massive TypeScript migrations, optimizing CI/CD pipelines, or standardizing modern tooling, I approach front-end development as a rigorous architectural discipline designed to solve complex business challenges.
